description: Test suite for the 'irr' module, testing functions for Cohen's kappa and Needleman-Wunsch identity calculations on observational data loaded from JSON and database.

classes.name: Test_irr
classes.description: Test class containing multiple test cases for 'irr' functions, using pytest framework.

methods.name: test_cohen_kappa_same_observation(self)
methods.description: Tests Cohen's kappa function on identical observations expecting perfect agreement score.

methods.name: test_cohen_kappa_very_different_obs(self)
methods.description: Tests Cohen's kappa on very different observations expecting a negative agreement score.

methods.name: test_cohen_kappa_very_similar_obs_interval_state_1s(self)
methods.description: Tests Cohen's kappa on similar observations with a 1-second interval expecting high agreement.

methods.name: test_cohen_kappa_very_similar_obs_interval_state_3s(self)
methods.description: Tests Cohen's kappa on similar observations with a 3-second interval expecting full agreement.

methods.name: test_cohen_kappa_very_similar_obs_interval_point_1s(self)
methods.description: Tests Cohen's kappa with a 1-second interval on similar observations expecting high agreement.

methods.name: test_cohen_kappa_very_similar_obs_interval_point_3s(self)
methods.description: Same as above but with a 3-second interval expecting high agreement.

methods.name: test_obs_without_events(self)
methods.description: Tests Cohen's kappa with one observation having no events, expecting a special value (-100).

methods.name: test_needleman_wunsch_identity_same_observation(self)
methods.description: Tests Needleman-Wunsch identity function on identical observations expecting 100% similarity.

methods.name: test_needleman_wunsch_identity_very_different_obs(self)
methods.description: Tests Needleman-Wunsch identity on very different observations expecting lower similarity (~85.84).

methods.name: test_needleman_wunsch_identity_very_similar_obs_state_1s(self)
methods.description: Tests high similarity (~99.37%) on similar observations with a 1s interval.

methods.name: test_needleman_wunsch_identity_very_similar_obs_state_3s(self)
methods.description: Tests perfect similarity (100%) on similar observations with a 3s interval.

methods.name: test_needleman_wunsch_identity_very_similar_obs_point_1s(self)
methods.description: High similarity (~99.3%) with 1s span on similar observations.

methods.name: test_needleman_wunsch_identity_very_similar_obs_point_3s(self)
methods.description: Almost perfect similarity (~97.92%) with 3s span on similar observations.
